stageChange: Replace analytic old light with Gaia RGB/RC member density. Add finite old and young Gaia points with a conserved luminosity budget. HERITAGE/Bell layer replaces molecular oval screens.

oldSelection.densitySampling: Uniform random_index <100,000,000, approximately 5.52% of Gaia DR3; the spatial sample is complete to its declared random-index threshold.
oldSelection.pointSampling: All selected old members with G<18 within 20 degrees; no random-index cut.
oldSelection.selection: Published RGB and RC polygons; signed parallax/error <5 and conditional orthographic proper-motion ellipse chi-square <9.21.
oldSelection.limitations: CMD phase proxies are not exact ages. Crowding, extinction and the magnitude limit affect completeness. No survey hole is filled from the photo.

population.barDiscPartition: The measured old-star density is split into a radial-median disc and its positive inner excess, tapered from 3 to 4 kpc. Their sum is the measured density. No analytic ellipse defines the light.
population.color: Gaia Vega magnitudes converted to AB using ESA DR3 zero-point differences, then RP/G/BP mean flux-density ratios serve as broad R/G/B proxies. One grade per population accounts for the photo passbands. No individual stellar colors are fitted.
population.depth: Deterministic height draws from the adopted layer, preserving each measured sky direction. Individual distances remain conditional.
population.grain: Each population budget is divided between unresolved light and real Gaia points. The same intrinsic G budget is conserved at every resolved fraction.
population.dust: Molecular optical-depth budget is redistributed into the HERITAGE-modulated layer and globally normalized to Bell. Finite oval screens are omitted.
population.densityWeighting: Measured Gaia G flux. All bright members with G<18 are used; faint RGB/RC random-sample fluxes are expanded by 18.11709771 to their declared sampling probability. Gaussian sigma remains 100 pc. The count-only trial is preserved in round1.

acceptance.contrast: The fixed masked 2–5 arcmin bar contrast must be closer to the photo than l18.
acceptance.geometry: Measured count field, fixed plane and warp; adopted old-disc 410 pc, bar 367 pc, young 150 pc Gaussian sigma.
acceptance.controls: Six global old/bar RGB coefficients and two global resolved fractions. Other population grades, catalogue amplitudes and the display curve remain at l18.

change: Blue structure only: Gaia smoothing from 200 to 100 pc, with global Gaia and young Bica-association gains.

details.associationSelection: Bica associations in young component, measured age below 400 Myr or the existing adopted 30 Myr spectrum when age is unknown.

gaiaMetadata.selection: Luri 2021 Young 1 + Young 2 CMD polygons; signed parallax/error <5; conditional orthographic proper-motion ellipse with chi-square <9.21.
gaiaMetadata.adaptation: Membership statistics use a uniform Gaia random_index <20,000,000 calibration subset within 5 degrees, G<19. DR3 photometry is used as published; no extra G correction.
gaiaMetadata.source: Gaia DR3 Young 1 + Young 2 proper-motion members

warpPlacement.method: Exact bilinear-cell intersections when fixed-point iteration fails. For multiple crossings, adopt the one nearest the flat midplane. At discontinuous support edges with no crossing, maximize the adopted 150 pc Gaussian height prior and report that finite-layer offset separately. The warp itself is unchanged.

gaiaMetadata.normalization: Unit-integrated equal-weight member counts. One global population luminosity and the existing component grade calibrate appearance.
gaiaMetadata.coverage: Complete archive query to 20 degrees. Zero selected counts remain zero before Gaussian smoothing. No survey-gap interpolation or analytic young-disc continuation.
gaiaMetadata.limitations: All-sky coverage is not uniform completeness: crowding, extinction and astrometric/photometric selection can still suppress young members. These CMD groups are age proxies, not measured individual ages.

barPopulationInputs.product: Qualified BC03 native-metallicity Johnson BVR integration

gaiaInput.product: Gaia DR3 old RGB/RC and Young 1/2 members

dustInput: Gordon 2014 HERITAGE BEMBB density, Bell normalized; preserved l19 input
